lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-intensity, roughly circular white spots arranged in vertical columns of approximately 3 to 5 nodes each, located posterior to the gill slits and above the pectoral fin insertion point.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with the circular blobs, creating a grid-like pattern where the blobs serve as primary nodes along the vertical axes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge is visible running along the mid-to-upper flank, characterized by a sharp transition from high pixel intensity on its upper edge to a shaded low-intensity region immediately below.

other_distinctive_markers: A remora fish (family Echeneidae) is attached to the ventral-lateral surface, visible as a dark, elongated silhouette below the primary horizontal ridge.
